title: Not All Entities are Created Equal: A Dynamic Anonymization Framework for Privacy-Preserving RAG
authors: Xinyuan Zhu; Zekun Fei; Enye Wang; Ruiqi He; Jia Guo; Ruijie Wang; Zheli Liu; Qingkai Zeng
